items.label: FIGURE 3.1
items.title: Livable planet dimensions
items.content: A circular diagram divided into three equal segments representing the dimensions of a livable planet: 1. Climate mitigation and adaptation, 2. Biodiversity and nature, and 3. Life essentials (air, water, food). Arrows follow the perimeter of the circle in a clockwise direction, indicating the interconnected nature of these dimensions. Source: Original figure for this publication (World Bank, n.d.).
